ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that the length of line segment $AB=20\,\text{cm}$, point C is on line $AB$, and $AC=4\,\text{cm}$. M and N are the midpoints of $AC$ and $BC$, respectively. What is the length of $MN$? in cm.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $AB=20\,cm$ and $AC=4\,cm$,\\
thus, $BC=AB-AC=20-4=16\,cm$,\\
since M and N are the midpoints of $AC$ and $BC$, respectively,\\
it follows that $MC=\frac{1}{2}AC$ and $CN=\frac{1}{2}BC$,\\
thus, $MN=\frac{1}{2}(AC+BC)=\frac{1}{2}(4+16)=\boxed{10}\,cm$.
